name: Adnan Dibrani - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Single Market and Customs Programme for the period 2028-2034 and repealing Regulations (EU) 2021/444, (EU) 2021/690, (EU) 2021/785, (EU) 2021/847 and (EU) 2021/1077
part_text:
The European Parliament wants one shared fund for the EU's single market, customs, tax and anti-fraud work from 2028 to 2034. It merges five existing programmes into one and raises the budget from about 6.2 billion euros to about 6.9 billion euros. It sets fixed shares of the money for each area, so the European Commission cannot move funds freely. It also asks for clearer goals, more say for Parliament over spending plans, and better protection of consumers and of the EU's money.

- The budget rises to about 6.9 billion euros, split into fixed shares for each policy area.
- It affects customs, tax and consumer authorities, businesses and consumers across the EU.
- Parliament votes on this position, then negotiates the final text with EU governments.
